pageTitle: Get Involved | Dr. Patience Tsavnande Foundation
pageDescription: Your Support Can Change Lives. Donate to support our medical outreaches, educational programs, and food security initiatives.
heroDescription: Every contribution helps us provide medical care, support education, and bring hope to vulnerable communities
donateSectionDescription: Choose an amount to make an immediate impact
allWaysToGiveDescription: Choose the method that works best for you
whereDonationGoesDescription: Every naira you donate makes a real difference

transparencyDescription: As a registered nonprofit organization, we are committed to full accountability. All donations are tracked and reported in our annual financial statements.
